title: Relationship Pricing Note: Ashgrove Income Annuities Addition to Part-Year Surrender Interest on Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
An owner who is receiving payments from an Ashgrove Income Annuities contract has an addition to the part-year surrender interest rate on that owner's Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contract.

## Rule

The income annuity relationship addition to the part-year surrender interest rate is:

- **0.10% (0.001)** where the owner has an Ashgrove Income Annuities contract in payout with at least **12** installments issued in the twelve months before the handling date;
- **0.05% (0.0005)** where the owner has an Ashgrove Income Annuities contract in payout with at least one but fewer than 12 such installments;
- nothing otherwise.

The addition is made to the rate at which the part-year surrender interest is worked.

## Records read

- The owner's Ashgrove Income Annuities contract and its status: it must be in payout (its income is active).
- That contract's activity history: the installments issued, dated in the twelve months before the handling date.

## Judgement table

| Owner's Income Annuities contract | Installments issued in the twelve months before the handling date | Addition |
|---|---|---|
| In payout | 12 or more | 0.10% |
| In payout | 1 to 11 | 0.05% |
| In payout | None | Nothing |
| Held but not in payout (for example completed) | Any number | Nothing |
| None held | — | Nothing |

*Worked case (hypothetical):* a monthly income annuity in payout that issued 12 installments in the period gives 0.10%; one that began payout four months before the handling date and issued 4 installments gives 0.05%.
